scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: Can an 8-bit fixed-point, correlation-preserving window graph pass a fresh exact-semantic holdout and expose a bounded controller update payload before any Micro Blossom latency or resource credit is claimed?

external_source_profile.source_interpretation: Micro Blossom supplies arbitrary static graph generation, unsigned dynamic edge-weight registers, and an external weight-load instruction. PyMatching 2.4.0 caps correlation-conditioned probability at 0.5, so its second-pass implied weights are nonnegative and only lower affected edges. This is interface compatibility evidence, not an implemented or timed hardware path.

known_before_preregistration.alternate_fusion_blossom_rejected_as_pri: the maintained Fusion Blossom README states PyMatching v2 has roughly 5x to 20x better single-thread performance, and Fusion Blossom does not expose the frozen two-pass correlated semantic as a drop-in interface

simple_zero_or_single_graph_edge_cache.decision: rejected because even zero-cost hits cannot meet the one-percent miss limit

fixed_point_diagnostic_on_observed_64_sh.disclosure: post-outcome route-selection diagnostic on an already observed corpus; it is not the preregistered result

controller_payload_diagnostic_on_observe.payload_encoding: 12-bit edge index plus 8-bit replacement weight for every unique potentially affected edge
controller_payload_diagnostic_on_observe.disclosure: upper-bound diagnostic; only a measured controller implementation can establish actual cycles or latency

candidate_contract.reference_full_block: unquantized PyMatching 2.4.0 two-pass correlated decode over the complete 1,000-round detector error model
candidate_contract.reference_online: unquantized public correction-bit fault-vector decoder under the frozen 3d window, d commit, and 2d look-ahead contract
candidate_contract.candidate: the same correction-bit online decoder after quantizing each decomposed detector-error probability by its log-likelihood weight
unchanged: distance-6 X/Z circuits, 71 active qubits, physical noise, and 1,000-round horizon
detector and observable correction-bit output maps
decomposed correlation groups and all graph endpoints
two-pass correlated matching, arrival order, propagation, frame, and residual rules
single-stream execution with no cross-shot batching
candidate_contract.changed: only the probability-derived base and implied weight values are represented on an 8-bit fixed-point grid

fresh_holdout_contract.seed_derivation: little-endian uint64 from the first eight SHA-256 bytes of public_freeze_commit:discussion_number:seed_namespace:basis

semantic_veto.veto_rule: no geometry or controller-payload result is credited if any required semantic or residual condition fails

controller_payload_contract.first_pass_path: decode_to_edges_array with correlations disabled on the quantized graph
controller_payload_contract.relation_table: every decomposed error component points to the other components in the same correlated mechanism
controller_payload_contract.affected_edge_count: unique union of relation-table targets for first-pass selected edges; an upper bound because PyMatching only applies a strictly lower implied weight
controller_payload_contract.latency_interpretation: payload bits are not cycles, bandwidth, p99 latency, LUTs, BRAMs, timing closure, or device evidence

kaggle_inspired_evaluation.verification_veto: fresh candidate frames, full-block reference frames, every residual, topology, seed, and corpus hash must verify before representation cost is discussed
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.cost_after_verification: report 8-bit weight payload and per-window dynamic update payload without converting them into unmeasured hardware latency
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.aggregate: X and Z must both pass; no average can hide a failed basis
kaggle_inspired_evaluation.absolute_guardrail: the existing p99 <=1 microsecond and deadline-miss <=1 percent gates remain open and cannot be waived by semantic admission

classification_rule.rule: apply the semantic veto first, then graph/weight admission; a pass only authorizes a cycle-accurate or real-device implementation experiment

execution_guard.preflight_before_publication: reconstruct every real graph, quantize weights, verify topology, output maps, unsigned range, and all-zero paths only; observe zero fresh stochastic samples
